items.title: Trump’s SEC wants to allow fund managers to charge extra fees for better performance. Here’s why it’s a terrible idea.
items.description: Think twice before embracing any new fund with high performance-related fees in your 401(k).

items.title: This couple took out an adjustable-rate mortgage when rates were over 8%. Here’s how it worked out.
items.description: Adjustable-rate mortgages have made a comeback as mortgage rates surge and buyers seek relief from high housing costs.

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg is coming for Apple’s empire
items.description: Apple has a grip on consumer technology through its iPhone business, but Meta is betting that the AI era warrants different types of hardware.

items.title: My wife never went back to work after raising our kids. Do I have to share my retirement savings 50/50?
items.description: “For 14 years I have gotten up every morning and gone to work while she has been free to pursue whatever interested her.”

items.title: 30-year mortgage rate posts biggest jump in four years — to nearly 7.3%
items.description: Mortgage rates surged to roughly a three-year high, a fresh setback for an already depressed housing market.

items.title: Tesla’s delivery report is just around the corner. Expect a sales drop.
items.description: Investors have become less interested in Tesla’s EV business lately, but Friday’s report still has the potential to be market-moving.

items.title: U.S. manufacturers say inflation is bad and not getting any better
items.description: American manufacturers are expanding and have plenty of new orders, but high energy prices and new Trump tariffs appear to be blocking even faster growth.

items.title: ‘We lived within our means’: I earned $30,000 as a pastor and still retired comfortably. Why don’t you tell people that?
items.description: “As a country, we have grown dangerously comfortable.”

items.title: September jobs report may show labor market is on the mend — but it’s far from cured
items.description: The U.S. job market has been stuck in what economists call a low-hire, low fire mode for the past two years — and the September employment report is likely to be in line with this unusual trend.

items.title: ‘I want to make her proud’: My mother, a divorcée, died and I’m her executor. Do I need to file for probate?
items.description: “The only debts were utility and credit-card bills, which we will pay off.”
